# Magic Memory

> AI photo restoration service. Restores old, blurry, faded, and damaged photos using GFPGAN — a face restoration AI model published at CVPR 2021 by Tencent ARC. Web-based, no app required. One-time credit packs (not a subscription) that never expire. There is no free tier: every restoration uses one credit, and a failed restoration costs none. Last verified 2026-11-06.

Magic Memory is positioned as the privacy-conscious, non-subscription alternative to Remini, MyHeritage Photo Enhancer, VanceAI, and Fotor. Processing completes in 5–15 seconds per photo. Photos are not retained after the session.

## Pricing snapshot (2026-11-06)

- Starter: €9.99 one-time for 20 credits (€0.50/photo)
- Growth: €19.99 one-time for 60 credits (€0.33/photo)
- Premium: €29.99 one-time for 120 credits (€0.25/photo) — cheapest per-photo rate
- Credits never expire. No subscription, no auto-renewal.

## Competitor pricing snapshot (2026-11-16)

- Remini: in-app subscription with weekly and monthly options (App Store listing); phone app plus a web version at app.remini.ai
- MyHeritage Photo Enhancer: unlimited use with the MyHeritage Photo subscription, or with the Complete or Omni plan (MyHeritage help center); price on MyHeritage's plans page
- VanceAI: monthly credit plans from $15/month billed yearly (Starter, 260 credits a month) and pay-as-you-go packs; 10 credits to try (vanceai.com/pricing)
- Fotor: free Basic plan with limited credits; Pro, Pro+ and Max subscriptions (fotor.com/pricing shows no prices)
